### Games PhasmaStrap did not start

- A game started from the Roblox app or a browser link is now picked up, so activity, the overlay, Discord presence and your party still see what you are playing
- There is a toggle for it on the Integrations page, under activity tracking
- FastFlags and mods are not applied to a session PhasmaStrap did not launch, because Roblox only reads those when it starts. If a game has its own flag profile you get the usual offer to restart into the same server with it

### Party

- Signing in updates the party page straight away instead of leaving the signed out card up until you navigate away
- Your party sees the name of the game you are in. It used to show "Place 123456" for the whole session, because where you are was recorded at the moment you joined, before the name had been fetched
- Following your party out of a game no longer opens the in game menu and no longer reports a crash afterwards. Asking the Roblox window to close is what opened that menu, and the kill that followed left no clean shutdown for the crash analyser to find

### Crashes

- When Roblox refuses to let a program load into the game, the crash report now names it. That line is in Roblox's own log and needs no crash dump, which is why crashes caused by an overlay used to come back as "neither Roblox nor Windows wrote down why"
- Overlays from NVIDIA, AMD, Intel, Xbox Game Bar, Discord, Steam, OBS, MSI Afterburner and ReShade are recognised by name, and the report says plainly when the cause is not PhasmaStrap

### Fixes

- Opening the editor from a screenshot notification and then closing it took the whole watcher down with it, which is what stopped the screenshot button, the tray icon and the overlay working until the next launch
- The watcher no longer throws while shutting down, from releasing a lock on a different thread than took it
